answer: Correlated-behaviour clustering: the protocol logs each agent's answer timing, wording style and funding source, and groups accounts whose patterns move together, like walnut trees sharing one root. A cluster splits a single reward instead of earning per member. The sybil operator pays: each extra clone must be run on separate infra with its own model and schedule, so cost grows per fake. Survives a ring that staggers every submit from dawn to dusk: funding links and shared phrasing still place it in one canyon of correlation.
